title: Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction
abstract: arXiv:2611.19122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning, yet in complex multi-step reasoning, an error at any step may propagate along an incorrect path, and the resulting solution may omit necessary branches. Existing natural-language reflection methods often struggle to locate critical errors precisely, while outcome verification typically checks only whether the available candidate answers satisfy the problem conditions and can therefore overlook necessary branches. To address these limitations, we propose Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV) for mathematical self-correction. AGPV decomposes the current solution into an ordered sequence of key claims, verifies them individually while invoking a shared mathematical toolbox when needed, and stops upon detecting the first error. translated_title: 面向数学自我纠错的智能体引导过程验证
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在数学推理方面已取得显著进展，然而在复杂的多步推理中，任何一步出现错误都可能沿着错误路径传播，且所得解答可能遗漏必要的分支。现有的自然语言反思方法往往难以精确定位关键错误，而结果验证通常只检查现有候选答案是否满足题目条件，因此可能忽略必要的分支。为解决这些局限，我们提出面向数学自我纠错的智能体引导过程验证（AGPV）。AGPV 将当前解答分解为有序的关键断言序列，逐项进行验证，并在需要时调用共享的数学工具箱，一旦检测到第一个错误即停止。总结智能体将失败证据转化为诊断信息，指导纠错智能体重新推导后续解答。
tldr: 提出智能体引导的过程验证方法 AGPV，通过将数学解答分解为有序关键断言并借助数学工具箱逐项验证、在首个错误处停止，再由总结智能体生成诊断指导纠错智能体重建解答，从而实现精确的自我纠错。
en_tdlr: We propose Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV), which decomposes a solution into ordered key claims, verifies each with a shared mathematical toolbox until the first error is found, and uses a summarization agent to generate a diagnosis that guides a correction agent to re-derive the solution.
